'''Tinn VI-B''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tinn VI]] in the [[Tinn system]]. [[Daxtorn Lethos]] hid his [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Gorgon (INT-66)|''Gorgon'']], in the moon's shadow while awaiting the arrival of a bounty in the Tinn system.
